reason: The gaze pattern shows frequent medium-to-large saccades across wide screen regions (both horizontally and vertically) interspersed with short and moderate fixations at many distinct locations, including repeated transitions between mid-page, top, and bottom areas—characteristic of scanning and navigating heterogeneous web content.
